interpretation_limits: No claim that absent details in this pinned paper establish absence of a mechanism in unpublished or uninspected implementation.

Section 5.3 points to Appendix B for fidelity validation, but the inspected appendix p22-23 provides formulas/assumptions rather than an independent simulator prediction-error table/plot. Calibration accuracy for the proposed RDMA/KV controls is not established here.
Candidate evaluation is simulator-backed; section 7 reports deployed cluster environments. Do not infer all reported experiments were simulator-only.
Pure-function policy hot-swap preserves current serving plans, but does not prove arbitrary KV/cache/graph/rank state migration or rollback.
Abstract average 34%/maximum 53% improvement must not be silently converted to measured SLO goodput, monetary savings or fractional runtime reduction.
API source, confidentiality boundary, own-service resource contention and all-in net benefit remain proposed comparison dimensions in this repository.
Original source-audit dates, upstream commits, research stages and unimplemented status remain unchanged.
